name: Hall of Champions
summary: The Hall of Champions is the inner sanctum of the Scarlet Monastery's armory wing. It serves as the seat of Herod, the Scarlet Champion, and a proving ground for the Scarlet Crusade's elite.

sections.title: Seat of the Scarlet Champion
sections.body: Situated past the Footman's Armory, the Hall of Champions lies at the heart of the monastery's armory wing. Here Herod, the Scarlet Champion, holds sway over the Crusade's fiercest fighters, and Scarlet trainees harden their resolve to purge Lordaeron of all undead and outsiders.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Hall of Champions?
faq.answer: The hall is the inner sanctum of the monastery's armory, where Herod, the Scarlet Champion, leads the Crusade's elite fighters and trainees hone their skills for the war against the undead.

faq.q: Who are the people immortalized in the statues?
faq.answer: No champions memorialized here are named in the records of this era. The hall's most famous figure is a living one: Herod, the Scarlet Champion, who guards the chamber.

faq.q: How does this hall differ from Stormwind's Champions' Hall?
aliases: hall of champions vs champions hall
faq.answer: Despite the similar name, this chamber is located deep inside the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades, dedicated to honored Scarlet figures. Stormwind City's Champions' Hall is a military garrison reserved for Alliance officers and PvP quartermasters.

angles.text: For knights of the Holy Light, facing the Scarlet Champion Herod in his own hall is a somber reminder of how genuine virtue and faith can become twisted by zealotry.
Human travelers from Lordaeron may recognize among the Crusade's champions former defenders of the northern kingdoms who threw their lot in with the fanatical Crusade.
